Vamsi has built evaluations for LLM systems both in his professional work at CVS Health and in his independent projects:

* **CVS Health:** He wrote telemetry endpoints that stored user ratings, comments, and prompt metadata in Cosmos DB to establish a human-in-the-loop evaluation loop. This data was used to drive prompt fixes, surface bugs, and prioritize new features.
* **Retail Support AI Agent (Project):** He wrote a tau-bench-style evaluation framework consisting of 12 multi-turn scenarios graded on final database state. He used this framework to iterate prompts through the agent development lifecycle (ADLC), raising task success from 75% to 100% and escalation accuracy from 83% to 100%.

(Sources: resume, Retail Support AI Agent README)
